title: 12 Best Taste northern Greek wines and ouzo pairings at Thessaloniki wine bars
description: Discover the best wine bars and ouzeris in Thessaloniki for authentic Northern Greek wines and traditional ouzo pairings. From cozy spots to upscale experiences, find your perfect meze match.

places.name: Oinovate
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A flight of indigenous Northern Greek wines (e.g., Xinomavro, Malagousia) paired with their truffle mushroom pie or cured meat platter.

places.name: Vogatsikou 3
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their slow-cooked lamb with a robust Xinomavro from Naoussa or Amyntaio, followed by a local cheese board.

places.name: The Aficionados
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Participate in a guided tasting session featuring wines from different Northern Greek regions, accompanied by a small platter of artisanal cheeses and charcuterie.

places.name: Mezen (Μέζεν)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Several rounds of aged tsipouro or ouzo, paired with their grilled octopus, 'soutzoukakia' (spicy meatballs), and smoked mackerel salad.

places.name: Chilai Wine Bar & Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bottle of a full-bodied Greek red (like a Limniona or Agiorgitiko) with their beef tagliata or a seafood pasta, followed by a cheese board.

places.name: Mia Feta
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A custom cheese and charcuterie platter featuring local Greek cheeses, paired with a crisp Assyrtiko or a fruity Malagousia.

places.name: Dotsi (Δώτση)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Several shots of ouzo from Lesvos or Plomari, accompanied by fried zucchini, saganaki, and their signature meatballs.

places.name: Loxias (Λοξίας)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A carafe of house red or white wine, paired with their grilled mushrooms, fried small fish (gavros), and a fresh Greek salad.

places.name: Kafeneio 'O Giatros' (Καφενείο 'Ο Γιατρός')
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy several rounds of ouzo with accompanying classic meze like olives, feta, bread, and perhaps some small fried fish or local sausages.

places.name: Paralio (Παράλιο)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Fresh grilled calamari or sardines with a chilled bottle of ouzo and a crisp white wine like Savatiano or Roditis.

places.name: Nea Folia (Νέα Φωλιά)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their moussaka or yemista (stuffed vegetables) paired with a robust local red wine served in a carafe.

places.name: Salonika Restaurant & Bar (Makedonia Palace)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bottle of a prestigious Xinomavro from a top estate, paired with a contemporary Greek dish like sea bass ceviche or slow-cooked veal, enjoyed from their terrace.
